activity.notes: El-Sisi served as Egypt's Minister of Defense and commander-in-chief of the armed forces from 12 August 2012 until resigning on 26 March 2014 to run for president. As of 2 September 2026 he remains the incumbent President of Egypt, so ATLAS does not fabricate an end date for that ongoing presidency; only this completed office is authored.

sources.title: Abdel Fattah el-Sisi — military and ministerial chronology
sources.citation_text: The chronology records his appointment as Minister of Defense on 12 August 2012.

sources.title: Sisi's resignation speech in full
sources.citation_text: El-Sisi announced on 26 March 2014 that he was retiring as Minister of Defense and leaving the military to run for president.

sources.title: Egyptian Presidency — President El-Sisi Holds Talks with President Xi Jinping
sources.citation_text: The Egyptian Presidency identifies Abdel Fattah El-Sisi as President on 2 September 2026, confirming that his presidency is still open-ended.
